blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s power regulators and the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) have reached a compromise to end their decades-long legal battle over permit and regulatory fees. On Thursday, both parties formally signed the compromise agreement, led by Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) Chair Francis Saturnino Juan and NGCP President and CEO Anthony Almeda.
